capabilities: Search illustration notes by free text and property filters
Filter by Bible passage, including Korean book abbreviations
Insert a wikilink, one application line or the full text into the current note
Skip hub and list notes that are not illustrations
Set the illustration folder and book folder in settings
disambiguation: Not an illustration generator or online search tool; it only searches illustration notes already in the vault.
extras: Interface and category lists are in Korean and follow the Pastor PKM Institute illustration standard. Source is viewable but the plugin is not open-source; free for personal, church and non-profit use. Version 0.3.0 renamed the default folders and shortened command IDs, so existing users must reset folders and hotkeys.
problem: Illustrations and quotes kept as notes are hard to locate by theme, tone or Bible passage while a sermon is being written.
summary: Searches sermon illustration notes by theme, type, tone, season, audience or Bible passage and inserts a link, text or application point into the current note.
